description: List the authenticated user's OpenTable reservations. Defaults to upcoming; pass scope="past" or scope="all" to broaden. Each entry includes the security_token needed to cancel or modify.

end_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; only reservations on or before this date (inclusive)

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; only reservations on or after this date (inclusive)

view.description: Response shape. "compact" (default) strips image/avatar URLs; "full" returns the parsed reservations untouched; "brief" answers one text line per reservation: "<restaurant>, party of <n> — <date>T<time> or no date — <status>", inside the untrusted-data envelope as data: string[] (restaurant names are third-party text); "-- none" when there are none.

name: opentable_list_reservations
